Students & Graduates

We Shape
Tomorrow's Bright Minds

We're paving the way for a new generation of leaders and innovators. Unlock your passion today!

Powering Knowledge through Education

PETRONAS believes that investing in education and human capital development at all levels will enable a continuous and sustainable pipeline of talent for PETRONAS, the industry, and the nation.

While PETRONAS aspires to realise its business goals, PETRONAS continues to uphold its contributions to sustainable development through improving access to quality education, promoting learning and development activities as well as enabling deserving recipients to realise their careers aspirations.

  • Education Sponsorship
  • Internship
  • Graduate Employability Enhancement Scheme (GEES)
  • Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)

 

 

Education Sponsorship (SPM Leavers)

A sponsorship programme for deserving SPM leavers to pursue their tertiary education at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP) and other top leading local and overseas universities in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, China, Japan and South Korea.

 

 

 

Eligibility Criteria

1. Outstanding Academic Achievements

  • SPM of the current year
  • Local Programme: Obtained minimum SPM 8A & CEFR (B1)
  • Overseas Programme: Obtained minimum SPM 4A+ & 4A & CEFR (C1)

Note: Please note that the eligibility criteria for your application may vary depending on your selected discipline (technical or non-technical). For more detailed information, please refer to the PETRONAS education sponsorship application guidelines available at the Online Application System during application period.

2. Strong Leadership

We look beyond academics and considers the impact that students have made outside of the classroom. Participation in clubs, sports, community service, leadership roles, and other activities can greatly enhance an application.

3. Wholesome Assessment

As part of our commitment to selecting the most deserving candidates, we have designed a comprehensive evaluation process to gain a deeper understanding of your unique qualities and capabilities.

  • Personality & Cognitive Assessment (Online assessment)
    This assessment evaluates your thinking abilities and inherent personality traits to understand how you process information, solve problems, and respond to situations. It helps us identify key attributes that align with the expectations and demands of a PETRONAS scholar.

  • Leadership Competencies Assessment (Online)
    This assessment focuses on your demonstrated behaviours and experiences throughout your secondary education. It aims to evaluate how you have applied leadership qualities in real-life contexts and the extent to which these competencies reflect the standards of a PETRONAS scholar.

  • Student Potential Assessment (Face-to-face assessment)
    This is a face-to-face interview where candidates will be assessed by our own PETRONAS assessors. The assessment is designed to measure candidates' leadership and behavioural qualities.

 

Terms & Conditions

This sponsorship opportunity is designed for individuals who exhibit outstanding talent, dedication, and potential.

Our selection committee is committed to identifying and nurturing the most promising talent among the applicant pool. In selecting the deserving wholesome talents, each application is carefully reviewed, considering academic achievements, personal character, leadership potential, and community impact.

As it is highly competitive, we want to emphasize that only those who meet the requirements will be shortlisted and selected for final award.

 

Application Period

The application for the sponsorship is now closed. Please stay tuned for the latest updates and future openings.

Mechatronic Engineering

Integrates mechanical engineering, electronics, and computing to develop smart and automated systems. Applied in robotics, automation, aerospace, and advanced manufacturing.

Mechanical Engineering

Deals with the design, analysis, and manufacturing of mechanical systems and components, encompassing areas such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and materials science. Mechanical engineers work on a vast array of items, from tiny Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) devices to massive power plants.

Electrical Engineers creates and manages electrical infrastructure, including substations, transformers, and distribution networks power systems for offshore platforms, refineries, and processing plants.

Internship

A dynamic platform designed to provide undergraduates experiential learning opportunity and first working exposure in the energy industry and engage in various areas of a global company's operations.

 

 

 

 

Eligibility Criteria
 

  1. Application is open for students pursuing:
    • Undergraduate degree from accredited local or overseas higher learning institutions where internship is a mandatory part of course completion in disciplines relevant to PETRONAS’ business needs.
    • Diploma from accredited local learning institutions in TECHNICAL or ENGINEERING disciplines where internship is a mandatory part of course completion in disciplines relevant to PETRONAS’ business needs.
  2. Minimum duration for internship is eight (8) weeks and maximum of twelve (12) months.
  3. Minimum CGPA of 3.00 or equivalent.
  4. The following documents MUST be submitted via the application portal (Incomplete submission will not be entertained):
    • Curriculum Vitae
    • Copy of latest academic results
    • Copy of the Industrial Training / Internship Letter by University

 

Terms & Conditions
 

  1. The application is open based on availability of placement and must be submitted three (3) months prior to the commencement of internship period.
  2. Only successful candidates will be contacted for internship placement. If you do not receive any reply from us within two (2) months after your application date, please consider your application as unsuccessful.
  3. Successful candidates will receive their offer letters exclusively via the PETRONAS myCareerX system. We will not issue offer letters via any other means.
  4. Only online applications will be processed. Email / postal / courier applications are deemed as incomplete and will not be entertained.
  5. Only the most qualified and suitable individuals are offered as PETRONAS internship hiring process is based on merit and equal access for all.
     

Application Period

GEES

PETRONAS is supporting PROTEGE-RTW initiative through its Graduate Employability Enhancement Scheme (GEES). GEES aims to enhance employability of new graduates to obtain long term employment or to set up their own businesses.

 

 

 

 

Eligibility Criteria
 

  1. Malaysian citizen not more than 26 years old (based on year of birth).
  2. Minimum Bachelor’s Degree holder with minimum CGPA of 3.00 or equivalent.
  3. Unemployed or under-employed in non-relevant areas of graduate’s qualifications.
  4. Have not attended any similar programme offered by other GLCs / companies.
  5. The following documents must be submitted via the application portal. Incomplete submissions will not be considered:
    • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
    • Full Academic Transcript
    • Study Completion Letter*

* In the event candidates are unable to provide official proof of study completion and/or cumulative CGPA at the point of application, an official endorsement letter issued by the university must be submitted. The letter must clearly confirm the candidate’s completion status and that the required CGPA has been achieved. Applications without valid supporting documentation will not be considered.

 

Terms & Conditions
 

  1. The application is open all year round. If you do not receive any reply from us within three (3) months after your application date, please consider your application as unsuccessful.
  2. Acceptance OR declination of offer must be notified within three (3) calendar days.
  3. Only online applications will be processed. Email / postal / courier applications are deemed as incomplete and will not be entertained.

 

Application Period

Explore the opportunities listed and click the button below to start your application.

Note: By submitting your application, you agree to our Data Privacy Statement. Click here to read the Data Privacy Statement for the GEES programme.

PETRONAS and TVET

For over 30 years, PETRONAS has been dedicated to developing human capital in Malaysia through various initiatives. We recognise that a sustainable talent ecosystem can be achieved through strategic collaboration among partners, particularly in the oil and gas sector. This collaboration benefits not only PETRONAS but also industry players and relevant stakeholders.

TVET has been identified as one of the main talent sourcing pools to meet the workforce requirements in oil and gas industry. Skilled talents such as welders, fitters, riggers, and scaffolders are continuously produced through these programmes.

PETRONAS remains committed to working with TVET stakeholders to ensure a sustainable pool of skilled workforce. Our in-house learning institutions, namely Institut Teknologi Petroleum PETRONAS (INSTEP), Akademi Laut Malaysia (ALAM), and Kimanis Petroleum Training Centre (KTC), offer TVET courses, among others.
 

Vocational Institution Sponsorship and Training Assistance (VISTA)

Since 1992, our Vocational Institution Sponsorship and Training Assistance (VISTA) programme has benefitted 37 institutions nationwide, with more than RM95 million invested to produce up to 14,000 graduates. Through this programme, assistance channeled to the selected institutions in terms of infrastructure, training materials, trainers, and curriculum readiness is aimed at ensuring that the identified technical training courses can be conducted according to industry standards and produce a competent workforce. 

PETRONAS collaborates with federal agencies’ and Sabah and Sarawak state governments’ TVET institutions such as selected Institut Kemahiran MARA (IKM), Institut Latihan Jabatan Tenaga Manusia (ILJTM), Akademi Binaan Malaysia (ABM), Centre of Technical Excellence Sarawak (CENTEXS), Jabatan Pembangunan Sumber Manusia (JPSM Sabah) and others, to produce talents with the right skills for the oil and gas industry.

Some of the offered courses include:

  • 6G Welding 
  • Pipe Fitting
  • Scaffolding
  • Wireman
  • Chargeman
  • Diploma courses such as Petrochemical and Process Instrumentation
     

Vocational Integrated Skilled Talent Advancement (VISTA i-plus)

In line with the Dasar TVET Negara 2030 introduced by the Government of Malaysia, and recognising the criticality to develop more local TVET skilled workers for oil and gas industry at pace, PETRONAS has elevated its existing VISTA programme into VISTA i-plus.

The Vocational Integrated Skilled Talent Advancement (VISTA i-plus) is designed to foster a whole-of-industry collaborative model, ensuring that all relevant stakeholders are actively involved in the skilled worker development programme. VISTA i-plus aims to:

  • promote Industry Talent readiness with cutting-edge skills and real-world applications.
  • strengthen Industry-Academia Collaboration to improve quality and funding.
  • support socio-economic growth via placement opportunities.

A VISTA i-plus Advisory Council (VAC) is established to drive the VISTA i-plus programme implementation at national level, with members from Human Resource Development Corporation (HRD Corp), Malaysia Petroleum Resources Corporation (MPRC), Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB) Malaysia, Malaysian Oil, Gas & Energy Services Council (MOGSC), Petroleum Arrangement Contractors (PAC) and PETRONAS.

VISTA i-plus aims to become the leading TVET programme for the oil and gas industry in Malaysia.

Together, we can drive meaningful transformation in Malaysia's TVET workforce.

For further enquiries, please reach out to vista.iplus@petronas.com.
